content: In our $\mathcal {D}_{test}$ dataset, on initial study we see a Word Error Rate of $\sim $50% for the ASR APIs and this number is not accurate because, 1) of the de-identification, 2) disfluencies (verbatim) difference between the human written and ASR transcript, and 3) minor alignment differences between the audio and the ground truth transcript.
